description: RO-LATE with the candidate CalcDb reader lease (native GENERIC_READ + FILE_SHARE_READ) instead of DAO readers. Processes a and b each hold such a native handle and read 4096 bytes; writer c tries at three points (both held; a closed with b held; both closed) a DAO shared read/write open with an UPDATE of row 1 (dbFailOnError), a DAO exclusive open and a native read/write share-zero handle, Errors before/after; a final independent DAO read of S row 1 follows. Asks whether the writer is denied throughout and admitted only after the last reader closes.
